commentaries.author: वामन-जयादित्यौ
commentaries.content: अन्त इत्यधिकृतम्। इत उत्तरं यद् वक्ष्यामस्तत्र पूर्वपदस्यान्त उदात्तो भवतीत्येवं वेदितव्यम्। वक्ष्यति — <<सर्वं गुणकार्त्स्न्ये>>[[६.२.९३]] — स॒र्वश्वे॑तः। स॒र्वकृ॑ष्णः। प्राग् <<उत्तरपदादिः>> [[६.२.१११]] इत्येतस्मादयमधिकारो वेदितव्यः॥

commentaries.author: हरदत्तः
commentaries.content: अत्रापि प्रकरणे पूर्वपदविशषया प्रथमा षष्ठ।ल्र्थे द्रष्टव्या ॥

commentaries.author: S.C. Vasu
commentaries.content: In the following sūtras up to निष्ठोपसर्गपूर्वमन्यतरस्याम् [[6.2.110]], inclusive, is to be supplied the phrase 'the last syllable in a word standing in the Nominative 1st-Case has the acute accent (उदात्त)'. This is an adhikara aphorism. In the succeeding sutras, the last syllable of the first member of a compound gets the acute accent. Thus in the next sutra the word सर्व gets acute on the final. This adhikara extends upto [[6.2.110]] inclusive.

commentaries.author: S.C. Vasu
commentaries.content: In the following sūtras up to निष्ठोपसर्गपूर्वमन्यतरस्याम् [[6.2.110]], inclusive, is to be supplied the phrase 'the last syllable in a word standing in the Nominative 1st-Case has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.
